entities.name: Gizem Örge
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gizem Örge is a Turkish volleyball player. Currently, she plays in the Turkish Women's Volleyball League for Fenerbahçe as libero. She was part of the Turkey women's national volleyball team, which became champion at the 2014 Women's European Volleyball League.
